state.customer_message: My order #58213 arrived two weeks late and the box was soaked. I want my money back.
state.reply: I’m sorry your order arrived late and damaged. I can’t promise a refund, but a colleague will review your case and confirm whether you’re eligible for one. If you’d like, I can also help you start the review for order #58213.

offers_refund.instructions: Does `reply` promise or offer a refund?

criteria.true: It commits to or offers a refund, even conditionally
criteria.false: It only says eligibility will be reviewed, or makes no refund commitment

asks_order_number.instructions: Does `reply` ask the customer for their order number?
